import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64,json
for page in [5,6,7,8]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1200','-singlefile','-png','inputs/sources/sphere.pdf'],capture_output=True)
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 enc=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode()
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),f'visual/source-page-{page}.png','--base64'],input=enc,text=True,capture_output=True); assert w.returncode==0,w.stderr
 print(json.dumps({'page':page,'png':enc}))
